routes.title: Resolve one exact Clay alternative
routes.question: Does every admissible smooth flow remain globally smooth, or can admissible smooth data force breakdown?

routes.kill_criterion: Only a terminal Clay-matching theorem closes this root.

routes.title: Global regularity
routes.question: Can every putative concentration be prevented or reduced to an impossible object?
routes.success: Global smoothness on R3 or T3.
routes.kill_criterion: A Clay-admissible smooth-data singularity would kill this universal route.

routes.title: Universal critical control
routes.question: Can the equation itself bound or shrink a critical continuation quantity?
entry_assumptions: Smooth solution on its maximal interval
routes.success: A universal critical bound feeding an established continuation criterion.
routes.kill_criterion: An exact smooth evolution with unbounded candidate quantity but no alternate criterion.

routes.success: A universal geometric modulus that closes all high-vorticity cores.
routes.kill_criterion: Construct an admissible concentrating flow geometry violating every proposed modulus.

routes.question: Must dangerous superlevel sets become sparse inside the viscous analytic radius?
routes.success: A universal sparseness criterion at every possible escape time.
routes.kill_criterion: A surviving concentration whose sparse scale never enters the analytic radius.

routes.title: Minimal blow-up and rigidity
routes.question: Can failure be reduced to a compact ancient object and that object be ruled out?
routes.success: A reduction theorem plus a Liouville or backward-uniqueness contradiction.
routes.kill_criterion: Essential noncompactness that cannot be captured by the selected critical topology.

entry_assumptions: A finite critical threshold or minimality principle
routes.success: Precompactness modulo exact Navier-Stokes symmetries.
routes.kill_criterion: A rigorously demonstrated multi-profile cascade with no minimal compact representative.

routes.title: Ancient-solution classification
routes.question: Which bounded or critical ancient solutions can exist?
entry_assumptions: An ancient limit with inherited local energy and critical bounds
routes.success: Classification reduces the limit to zero or an already excluded profile.
routes.kill_criterion: Construction of a nontrivial ancient solution meeting every inherited bound.

routes.title: Backward uniqueness and Liouville rigidity
routes.question: Can vanishing at a terminal slice force the ancient object to vanish identically?
entry_assumptions: Enough decay and coefficient control for unique continuation
routes.success: A contradiction with nontrivial normalized concentration.
routes.kill_criterion: A counterexample at the exact regularity and growth level inherited from rescaling.

routes.title: Remove assumptions from conditional criteria
routes.question: Can a structured criterion be extended until it covers every singularity class?
routes.success: A finite covering/reduction whose leaves are all excluded.
routes.kill_criterion: An explicit survivor outside all derived criteria.

routes.title: Single point to arbitrary cores
routes.question: Can one replace a fixed ball by moving, multiple, or anisotropic coverings without losing the gain?
entry_assumptions: Geometry beyond bare weak-L(3/2) volume control
routes.success: A covering theorem whose entropy cost remains absorbable.
routes.kill_criterion: A packing geometry whose necessary covering loss consumes the entire subcritical gain.

routes.title: Imposed geometry to derived geometry
routes.question: Can Navier-Stokes evolution exclude the nonzero coherent ancient suitable weak-L3 distance profile with two locally finite terminal singular points and uniform positive Albritton-Barker quotient defect? On its compact dilation hull, can a recursive defect-event law be proved to have finite mean roof? In the complementary infinite-mean branch, the reviewed renewal, no-return, and coefficient-tail theorems force actual common-trajectory dissipation above parabolic and superparabolic cutoffs. The reviewed parabolic ancestry theorem proves that next-event cutoff reach imposes the sharp seven-sixths relative log-scale ceiling, but its smooth divergence-free kinematic survivor still realises every nested payment by placing mass arbitrarily far above the cutoff. The reviewed parabolic flux theorem first turns such far placement into comparable-annulus dissipation, inherited entrance energy, or positive signed cumulative flux. The reviewed inherited-ancestry theorem now uses one fixed-time H1 tail, a last-hitting argument, and an event-adaptive annulus squeeze to force every sufficiently late pressure-tail event to have positive terminal signed input at a cutoff K_j/Lambda_j tending to one. The reviewed weak-L3 lower-band flux-decrement theorem further proves that every such late event dissipates a fixed fraction c(nu/M)^2 of that signed high-pass input in a lower transition band, closing the near-lossless distinct-shell survivor. The exact shell and Zeno ledgers nevertheless permit infinitely many geometrically decreasing payments and do not make these lower bands fresh or bounded-overlap. The exact frequency-localised primal-adjoint pairing does telescope, but every pressure contribution pairs to zero against the projected solenoidal fields; its periodic high-high-to-fixed-low example closes this bare pressure-blind telescope without excluding a genuinely mixed functional. The recorded spatial primal-adjoint current is pressure-visible, but the reviewed Beltrami cancellation now shows that its gauge-invariant signed cutoff flux can vanish in every gauge while pressure history remains positive. Can a pressure-component or pressure-polar functional, a canonically gauge-fixed current norm with cancellation control, another NSE-specific mixed functional, bounded lower-band overlap, a scale-zero floor, frequency-locality, non-Zeno cascade-speed, or an intervening-event theorem make the forced terminal flux decrement event-index fresh, or can the 9/4 coefficient cost be coupled to the event clock strongly enough to stop the physical zoom? Can the inverse-15/4 direct ancestor be excluded, a finite-secondary-index estimate sum the disjoint scale-matched adjoint-pressure annuli, the resulting history law bound the finite-branching hierarchy depth, the bounded-centering clock packet be coupled to the subnatural tensor carrier, or the other finite-horizon and eternal parent candidates be excluded? Separately, can a carrier-to-next-parent genealogy be constructed for a two-edge suitable-process argument?
entry_assumptions: Smoothness before a first singular time
routes.success: A finite-mean theorem for one recursive defect-event law gives the compact parabolic scaling hull an invariant probability distinct from delta-zero. Alternatively, an NSE same-trajectory theorem makes the now-forced terminal signed cumulative flux decrement event-index fresh by proving a quantitative pressure-component or pressure-polar telescope, a canonically gauge-fixed current estimate with cancellation control, bounded lower-band overlap, a scale-zero floor, frequency locality, non-Zeno cascade speed, or an intervening event; coupling the 9/4 coefficient cost to the clock could instead stop the physical zoom. The operator-label ambiguity, separated-return participation antecedent, bare next-event coupling proposal, arbitrary far-tail placement without an NSE energy consequence, inherited-state and event-adaptive annular bookkeeping, near-lossless distinct-shell flux ledger, bare frequency-localised primal-adjoint pairing telescope, and bare gauge-invariant spatial cutoff-current telescope are closed. Their surviving outputs are the sharp seven-sixths relative log-scale ceiling, positive terminal signed flux at a cutoff asymptotic to the parabolic boundary, a fixed weak-L3 lower-band dissipation decrement, a pressure-blind frequency commutator telescope, and an exactly cancelling pressure-visible spatial current. Finite raw dissipation, absolute continuity, terminal nesting, nonnegative tail monotonicity, positive cumulative high-pass flux, a fixed relative decrement without cross-event overlap control or a scale-zero floor, natural parabolic heat clocks, positive scalar majorants, abstract skew energy, adjoint energy, unaugmented spectral primal-adjoint pairing, and unseparated spatial cutoff current alone are explicitly insufficient. In the direct branch, one-trajectory suitable compactness retains and excludes the inverse-15/4 ancestor. A finite-secondary-index or cancellation estimate can instead sum the disjoint finite-horizon annular packets and force every terminal pairing to vanish. Any such result yields the required weak-L3 scale-hull Liouville theorem or a summable cost per level of the uniformly finite-branching satellite hierarchy. A tensor and frequency bridge excludes the remaining parent-local concentration, and a first-singular-time history bound or rigidity theorem excludes the other finite-horizon and eternal fixed-shell parent candidates; a separate nested-array theorem is required only for a two-edge carrier shift-process route.
routes.kill_criterion: A Clay-admissible single trajectory or nonzero coherent scale-aperiodic suitable weak-L3 ancient distance profile with at least two locally finite terminal singular points, compact recurrent critical-dilation hull, uniform positive Albritton-Barker quotient defect, and no dynamical scale-hull monotonicity, together with a terminal pressure cascade whose direct response forces inverse-15/4 coefficient dissipation through scale-critical ancestors on collapsing h-to-the-seventeen-halves clocks, or whose feedback branch satisfies the fixed lower-band flux decrement yet spends geometrically or stretched-exponentially decreasing coefficient dissipation while the physical zoom shrinks still faster so that every dissipation-scale clock and history charge vanishes and the pressure persists beyond c log(1/h) Stokes-Duhamel interactions while evading every Oseen-specific summable or quasi-nilpotent law, positive critical causal majorants retaining order-one spectral radius and all available higher-integrability pairs remaining super-Serrin; every genuine aggregate loses the Besov micro-mark and escapes history bounds and further interaction-order gains; an infinite-depth uniformly finite-branching terminal satellite hierarchy has no summable same-trajectory depth charge; or a parent-local finer concentration sheds every tensor mark into a nested tower outside every available rigidity class.
